mapper.select: SELECT t.USER_ID AS id, t.USER_NAME AS NAME, t.USER_REALNAME AS realName, t.DEPT_ID as deptId, t.dept_name AS deptPathName, t.IS_ADMIN AS isAdmin, t.job_name AS jobName, t.EMP_ACCOUNT empAccount, t.AUTH_MODE authMode, t.PASSWORD password, DATE_FORMAT(t.CREATED_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') createdTime FROM bi_portal.sys_user t WHERE 1 = 1 AND t.IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND t.USER_NAME = #{userName}

SELECT t.USER_ID AS id, t.USER_NAME AS NAME, t.USER_REALNAME AS realName, t.DEPT_ID as deptId, t.dept_name AS deptPathName, t.IS_ADMIN AS isAdmin, t.job_name AS jobName, t.EMP_ACCOUNT empAccount, t.AUTH_MODE authMode, t.PASSWORD password, DATE_FORMAT(t.CREATED_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') createdTime FROM bi_portal.sys_user t WHERE 1 = 1 AND t.IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND t.USER_NAME in
#{item}

select hr1.USER_NAME as userName from bi_portal.hr_employee hr1 inner join ( select user_auth.user_name from ( SELECT t.`owner_id` AS user_name FROM bi_portal.sys_data_auth t WHERE 1=1 and t.`owner_type` = 'User' AND t.`module_code` = 'ssd_ctg' AND t.`dim_code` = 'ssm_ctg' AND t.created_time > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -1* t.active_duration_days DAY)
UNION ALL
SELECT sur.USER_NAME AS user_name FROM bi_portal.sys_data_auth t1 INNER JOIN bi_portal.sys_user_role sur ON t1.`owner_id` = sur.ROLE_ID WHERE 1=1 and t1.`owner_type` = 'Role' AND t1.`module_code` = 'ssd_ctg' AND t1.`dim_code` = 'ssm_ctg' AND sur.created_time > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -1* sur.active_duration_days DAY)
UNION ALL
SELECT hr2.USER_NAME as user_name FROM bi_portal.sys_data_auth t1 inner join bi_portal.hr_employee hr2 on CONCAT(hr2.dept_id, '/') LIKE CONCAT('%', t1.owner_id, '/%') WHERE 1=1 and t1.owner_type= 'Dept' AND t1.`module_code` = 'ssd_ctg' AND t1.`dim_code` = 'ssm_ctg' AND t1.created_time > DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL -1* t1.active_duration_days DAY) ) user_auth group by user_auth.user_name ) user_auth2 on hr1.user_name = user_auth2.user_name where concat(hr1.dept_id , '/') like concat('%', #{deptId}, '/%')

SELECT d.deptLeaderEMail, IF ( isnull( d.applicantDept ) , '', SUBSTR( d.applicantDept, 1, CHAR_LENGTH( d.applicantDept ) - 1 ) ) AS applicantDept FROM ( SELECT concat( IF ( isnull( t1.dept1_name ) OR t1.dept1_name = '', '', concat( t1.dept1_name, '-' ) ), IF ( isnull( t1.dept2_name ) OR t1.dept2_name = '', '', concat( t1.dept2_name, '-' ) ), IF ( isnull( t1.dept3_name ) OR t1.dept3_name = '', '', concat( t1.dept3_name, '-' ) ), IF ( isnull( t1.dept4_name ) OR t1.dept4_name = '', '', concat( t1.dept4_name, '-' ) ), IF ( isnull( t1.dept5_name ) OR t1.dept5_name = '', '', concat( t1.dept5_name, '-' ) ) ) AS `applicantDept`, t1.manager_level2_user_name AS deptLeaderEMail FROM bi_portal.hr_employee t1 WHERE t1.IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND t1.USER_NAME = #{userName} ) d

SELECT biu.USER_ID AS id, biu.USER_NAME AS name, biu.USER_REALNAME AS realName, biu.dept_name AS deptPathName, biu.IS_ADMIN AS isAdmin, biu.IS_ACTIVE AS isActive, biu.EMP_ACCOUNT empAccount, biu.AUTH_MODE AS authMode, DATE_FORMAT(biu.CREATED_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') createdTime FROM bi_portal.sys_user biu WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY deptPathName desc, USER_NAME LIMIT ${pageRowLower}, ${prePageSize}
